title: Six-leaf range-local scan with charged 184-bit candidates

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the cold six-leaf range-local stored-leaf algorithm in proof.md recovers x with success at least 0.3900001 under the explicitly stated scalar-machine/ideal-coin conventions, with total work on every run at most 2^125.362709211237 target-operation equivalents at C=1000 instructions. All preprocessing, transfers, coordination, failures, enlarged partial-key candidate processing and final scalar verification are charged. q1=145286892, q2=2^25, six leaves per incidence, 2^72 nodes; the scan compares K2 only inside d4 ranges and uses the complete 184-bit false-match accounting with capacities 2^28/2^29/2^30. Peak memory is at most 2^135.9988 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^110.2061 units is included. No free advice, future amortization or quantum operation is used. The complete source argument is supplied as baseline-proof.md and all changes are proved in proof.md. No prior verdict or finite test substitutes for the production argument. The exact ledger R_total=54693511865951618186170960644676420370432 instructions yields a bound below the declared score. No production execution or human approval is claimed.

experiments.purpose: Production-field six-leaf/inversion checks, 4x4 routing with every delivery, exact path-count models, full-cap cases, 1200 isolated range-scanner cases, toy collision controls and exact cost/success arithmetic. No production-scale attack.
